sql_template:
SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.row_json->>'customer_id'), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c.row_json->>'customer_id'), ''), 'Unknown') AS customer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'event_id') AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'contract_id') AS contract_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((s.row_json->>'quantity'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)), 0) AS total_quantity,
    COALESCE(SUM(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((s.row_json->>'quantity'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0) *
        COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((c.row_json->>'price_per_unit'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)
    ), 0) AS total_expected_amount
FROM dataset_rows s
LEFT JOIN dataset_rows c
    ON c.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
    AND c.sheet_name = 'Contracts_RateCard'
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(c.row_json->>'contract_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'contract_id')), '')
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(c.row_json->>'customer_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'customer_id')), '')
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(c.row_json->>'service_type')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'service_type')), '')
WHERE s.dataset_id = %(dataset_id)s
  AND s.sheet_name = 'Ops_Events'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_expected_amount DESC, event_count DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s
description: Customer summary join between Ops_Events and Contracts_RateCard using quantity and price_per_unit to compute expected amount.

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'event_id') AS event_count,

LEFT JOIN dataset_rows i
    ON i.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
    AND i.sheet_name = 'Invoices_Synthetic'
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(i.row_json->>'event_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'event_id')), '')

  AND s.sheet_name = 'Ops_Events'

ORDER BY total_expected_amount DESC, event_count DESC

description: Customer summary join between Ops_Events and Invoices_Synthetic using expected and billed amount metrics.

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.row_json->>'customer'), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.row_json->>'customer'), ''), 'Unknown') AS customer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'event_id') AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.row_json->>'invoice_id') AS invoice_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((s.row_json->>'expected_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)), 0) AS total_expected_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((i.row_json->>'billed_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)), 0) AS total_billed_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((s.row_json->>'expected_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0) - COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((i.row_json->>'billed_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)), 0) AS total_value_gap
FROM dataset_rows s
LEFT JOIN dataset_rows i
    ON i.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
    AND i.sheet_name = 'Invoices_Synthetic'
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(i.row_json->>'event_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'event_id')), '')
WHERE s.dataset_id = %(dataset_id)s
  AND s.sheet_name = 'Ops_Events'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_value_gap DESC, total_expected_amount DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s
description: Customer summary of expected amount, billed amount, and value gap across Ops_Events and Invoices_Synthetic.

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.row_json->>'customer'), ''), 'Unknown') AS customer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'event_id') AS uninvoiced_event_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((s.row_json->>'expected_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)), 0) AS total_uninvoiced_expected_amount
FROM dataset_rows s
LEFT JOIN dataset_rows i
    ON i.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
    AND i.sheet_name = 'Invoices_Synthetic'
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(i.row_json->>'event_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'event_id')), '')
WHERE s.dataset_id = %(dataset_id)s
  AND s.sheet_name = 'Ops_Events'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.row_json->>'status', ''))) = 'completed'
  AND i.row_index IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_uninvoiced_expected_amount DESC, uninvoiced_event_count DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s
description: Completed Ops_Events without matching invoices, summarized by customer.

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.row_json->>'customer'), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.row_json->>'customer'), ''), 'Unknown') AS customer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'event_id') AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.row_json->>'invoice_id') AS invoice_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.row_json->>'event_id') - COUNT(DISTINCT i.row_json->>'invoice_id') AS uncovered_event_count
FROM dataset_rows s
LEFT JOIN dataset_rows i
    ON i.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
    AND i.sheet_name = 'Invoices_Synthetic'
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(i.row_json->>'event_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'event_id')), '')
WHERE s.dataset_id = %(dataset_id)s
  AND s.sheet_name = 'Ops_Events'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY uncovered_event_count DESC, event_count DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s
description: Customer-level invoice coverage summary between Ops_Events and Invoices_Synthetic.

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.row_json->>'customer'), ''), 'Unknown') AS customer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(i.row_json->>'invoice_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN s.row_json->>'event_id'
        ELSE NULL
    END) AS billed_event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(i.row_json->>'invoice_id'), '') IS NULL THEN s.row_json->>'event_id'
        ELSE NULL
    END) AS unbilled_event_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(i.row_json->>'invoice_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((i.row_json->>'billed_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END), 0) AS total_billed_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(i.row_json->>'invoice_id'), '') IS NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace((s.row_json->>'expected_amount'), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END), 0) AS total_unbilled_expected_amount
FROM dataset_rows s
LEFT JOIN dataset_rows i
    ON i.dataset_id = s.dataset_id
    AND i.sheet_name = 'Invoices_Synthetic'
    AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(i.row_json->>'event_id')), '') = NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(s.row_json->>'event_id')), '')
WHERE s.dataset_id = %(dataset_id)s
  AND s.sheet_name = 'Ops_Events'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.row_json->>'status', ''))) = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_unbilled_expected_amount DESC, unbilled_event_count DESC, billed_event_count DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s
description: Completed Ops_Events summarized by customer into billed versus unbilled event counts and amounts.
